      "observations": [
        "All65owned path diffs read, including the changed C++ test. The patch removes cached/global XPCOM preference handles and libmime per-display m_prefBranch/GetPrefBranch, changes utility signatures/callers and InitDisplayFormats to void, and retains branch objects where child enumeration or per-identity/per-account branches are required. Static Preferences use in these affected C++ sections is accepted local source, not a universal API/import rule or a ban on branch interfaces.",
        "The change is not entirely mechanical: GetUniqueAccountKey removes the fallback for unavailable preference service; GetPromptPurgeThreshold/GetWarnFilterChanged now return the direct fallible read instead of swallowing a read failure as false/NS_OK. Current AutoCompact checks that status and returns before using prompt, while AlertFilterChanged initializes checkBox=false and ignores status. The 500MB purge threshold fallback and conversion to KiB remain explicit. These distinct callers must not be merged into one failure-policy claim.",
        "GetMailNewsFont previously assigned rv from its user font-size read. The new Preferences::GetInt call drops that assignment but keeps the following NS_FAILED(rv) check, which still examines the successful charset-language lookup. The default-branch size read separately updates rv. Current plain body renderer appends fontPixelSize when the helper reports success. This is an unchecked fallible read, not a reproduced corrupt font or proof that normal configured profiles fail.",
        "Several defaults remain explicit: image resizing=true, local folder delete confirmation=true, MAPI warning=true, wraplength72, IMAP header chunk200 and offline support regular. Other conversions replace initialized/out-parameter reads with value getters, including IMAP mark-read-auto and keepalive intervals. Keepalive timing values are now read without a status check then clamped; a negative configured value still skips update. uint maximum-token retrieval replaces signed retrieval plus cast and does not establish a new input range guarantee.",
        "The forward subject prefix changes from GetCharPrefWithDefault to initializing \"Fwd\" before GetCString. Checked local Gecko GetCString starts by setting the output void; the initializer alone is not proof that failed reads preserve a Fwd fallback. Gecko context is exact public source at8a7f5001d25b58d4799e19bfed316f872dcc739c, but its pairing with accepted comm is unverified. Treat this as a bounded source question rather than a demonstrated application regression.",
        "The changed TestMsgStripRE sets the UTF-8 localized prefix with SetCString and removes its preference-service acquisition assertion. Historical full test inspected: four MIME-encoded localized prefix examples check modified text and didModify through an integer-return helper. EXPECT_TRUE sites have no streamed assertion messages. It adds no missing/wrong-type preference, font, purge or platform default tests. That historical test path is absent at accepted comm; no current test equivalence is claimed. No C++ build, GTest, platform shell/MAPI, mail render, preference failure or network test ran.",
        "Read full Bug1971637 description/comments0–6 and all three folded review histories: D253412 zero submitted inlines, D253447 one actual submitted inline body, D253473 zero, each creation-to-final with footer. Bug comment6 explicitly says three patches were rolled into the giant landed patch. The full owned 65-path landing was inspected; no one review is treated as covering only an inferred subset or as proof of all fallback semantics.",
        "The D253447 inline asks for value-returning getters where available and explicitly says strings lack that form. Its concrete example assigns GetInt(..., OFFLINE_SUPPORT_LEVEL_REGULAR), matching the landed default-preserving conversion. The comment does not remove fallible-getter contracts where status is returned or authorize dropping error checks. Both direct return and value forms remain in the owned code. Source-supported purge and font findings remain exact comm claims; the separate new unpaired Gecko snapshots stay private for bounded source ingestion.",
        "In D253412 the author asks reviewers to check Get/Set mixups and says tests found one. This is a historical report without the exact bad version or executed test result; no new mistaken call is invented. Bug performance wording is an author expectation, not a measurement. Earlier remote build completions and later failures/ongoing landing are separate statuses. Sparse acceptance does not establish current branch behavior, platform validation, successful final build or blanket style policy. No tests, build, lint, preference failure or OS UI execution ran."
